subject: QSOLKCB/QSOL-CONTEXT
purpose: reconstruct the QSOL-TIMELOCK publication executor after long-term runtime or platform loss
recovery_steps: Verify the recovered QSOL-ORACLE artifact set against a deterministic release fingerprint or independently preserved hashes.
Re-read the founding QSOL-TIMELOCK/1 contract and confirm no newer authenticated maintainer directive supersedes it.
Resolve the then-current repository host and obtain a fresh complete local copy of the exact candidate source commit.
Run the local publication classification scanner and produce a new clearance receipt; any unclassified, permanent-deny, redaction-required, sensitive, or unsafe-symlink result blocks publication.
Implement or select a current platform adapter conforming to QSOL-PUBLICATION-EXECUTOR-INTERFACE/1; do not restore historical credentials.
Obtain current platform authorization at execution time and perform a dry run first.
Execute only when the timelock is eligible, the clearance receipt is cleared, current authority is independently available, and the adapter can verify the postcondition.
Publish archival copies according to the multi-location plan and retain public receipts without treating archive presence as semantic truth.
